command: for i in $(seq 1 6); do WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); OUT=$(WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean)})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){process.stdout.write(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'); echo "DASHBOARD_POLL_$i=$OUT"; printf '%s' "$OUT" >/tmp/lcl_dashboard_last.json; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); raise SystemExit(0 if d.get("text","").find("Shelly Plug S Gen3")>=0 and "Open system" in d.get("buttons",[]) else 1)'; then break; fi; sleep 5; done; python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/lcl_dashboard_last.json")); assert "Shelly Plug S Gen3" in d["text"] and "Open system" in d["buttons"]; print("DASHBOARD_FINAL_BEGIN"); print(d["text"]); print("DASHBOARD_FINAL_END")'
